# CANDIDATE: OVERNIGHT_GAP_FILL_VWAP_MEANREV_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large overnight gaps (>0.5%) that open below the prior day's low tend to partially fill within the first 30 minutes as liquidity returns, pulling price back toward the intraday VWAP. This mean-reversion edge exists because overnight imbalances often correct when regular-hour participants enter, creating a high-probability retracement toward VWAP before directional momentum resumes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** 
- Overnight gap = |open - prior close| / prior close > 0.005 
- AND open < prior day's low (gap down) 
- AND price crosses above VWAP within first 30 minutes of RTH 
- AND 5-minute volume at crossover bar > 1.5 × average 5-minute volume of prior 20 bars 
- Enter long at close of the bar that first closes above VWAP.

**Exit:** 
- Primary stop: chart-stop at prior day's low (gap level) if price closes below it 
- Profit-take: TP1 at 1R (risk = entry price - stop level) 
- Runner: trail stop at 15% below highest-watermark price after TP1 
- Time exit: 10:30 EST hard cutoff if neither stop nor TP1 hit.

**Regime filters:** 
- Only trade when VIX < 20 (low volatility) 
- Avoid major news windows (FOMC, CPI, NFP) within 60 minutes of entry 
- Restrict to 09:30-10:30 EST window.
